mapper.select: SELECT m.*, s.stadium_nm, f.field_nm, f.file_idx, fl.file_path, mt.match_type_nm, mt.total_players, min_lvl.tier AS min_level_name, max_lvl.tier AS max_level_name, mt.match_type_nm AS match_method, match_state.match_stts, p.`name`, COUNT(ma.match_no) AS application_count FROM matches m INNER JOIN match_types mt ON m.match_type_cd = mt.match_type_cd INNER JOIN levels min_lvl ON m.min_level_cd = min_lvl.level_cd INNER JOIN levels max_lvl ON m.max_level_cd = max_lvl.level_cd INNER JOIN `fields` f ON m.field_no = f.field_no INNER JOIN stadium s ON s.stadium_no = f.stadium_no INNER JOIN match_statuses match_state ON m.match_stts_no = match_state.match_stts_no INNER JOIN files fl ON f.file_idx = fl.file_idx INNER JOIN provinces p ON s.province_id = p.province_id LEFT JOIN match_applications ma ON m.match_no = ma.match_no WHERE m.match_stts_no = 1 OR m.match_stts_no = 2 GROUP BY m.match_no, s.stadium_nm, f.field_nm, f.file_idx, fl.file_path, mt.match_type_nm, mt.total_players, min_lvl.tier, max_lvl.tier, match_state.match_stts, p.`name`

mapper.select: WITH game_wins AS ( SELECT match_no, win_team_cd AS team_cd, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM match_results GROUP BY match_no, win_team_cd ), match_final_teams AS ( SELECT match_no, team_cd, wins, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY match_no ORDER BY wins DESC) AS rank_num FROM game_wins ), final_scores AS ( SELECT match_no, MAX(CASE WHEN rank_num = 1 THEN team_cd END) AS final_winner_cd, MAX(CASE WHEN rank_num = 1 THEN wins END) AS winner_score, MAX(CASE WHEN rank_num = 2 THEN team_cd END) AS final_loser_cd, MAX(CASE WHEN rank_num = 2 THEN wins END) AS loser_score FROM match_final_teams GROUP BY match_no ) SELECT m.match_no, m.match_date, m.match_time, m.match_end_time, s.stadium_nm, m.gender_nm, min_lvl.tier AS min_level_name, max_lvl.tier AS max_level_name, winner_team.team_nm AS winner_team_name, loser_team.team_nm AS loser_team_name, fs.winner_score, COALESCE(fs.loser_score, 0) AS loser_score FROM final_scores fs INNER JOIN matches m ON fs.match_no = m.match_no INNER JOIN team winner_team ON fs.final_winner_cd = winner_team.team_cd LEFT JOIN team loser_team ON fs.final_loser_cd = loser_team.team_cd INNER JOIN `fields` f ON m.field_no = f.field_no INNER JOIN stadium s ON f.stadium_no = s.stadium_no INNER JOIN levels min_lvl ON m.min_level_cd = min_lvl.level_cd INNER JOIN levels max_lvl ON m.max_level_cd = max_lvl.level_cd INNER JOIN match_statuses ms ON m.match_stts_no = ms.match_stts_no WHERE ms.match_stts = '매치 종료' ORDER BY m.match_date DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM match_likes WHERE match_no=#{matchNo} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM match_likes WHERE match_no = #{matchNo} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_nm, GROUP_CONCAT(t.team_cd SEPARATOR ', ') AS team_codes, GROUP_CONCAT(t.team_nm SEPARATOR ', ') AS team_names FROM match_applications ma LEFT JOIN `user` u ON ma.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN team_user tu ON u.user_id = tu.user_cd LEFT JOIN team t ON tu.team_cd = t.team_cd WHERE ma.match_no = #{matchNo} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_nm;
